options.text: Tim would be better off taking the bus to work.

Many commuters will complain about the new train schedule.

explanation:
The passage tells us that Tim's com mute didn't bother him because he was always able to sit down and
comfortably read or do paperwork. Therefore, it is reasonable to assume that Tim's commute has
become less com fortable since the schedule change, because it is very crowded and he can no lon ger
find a seat. There is no information given that supports choices 1, 3, and 4.

statement:
Write the number of the correct choice. 
Today is Varun's birthday. One year, from today he will be twice as old as he was 12 years ago. How old 
is Varun today?
explanation:
Let Varun's age today =  𝑥 years.
Then, Varun's age after 1 year =  (𝑥 +  1) years.
Therefore 𝑥 +  1 =  2 (𝑥 –  12)
⇒   𝑥 +  1 =  2𝑥 −  24 ⇒   𝑥 =  25.
